chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: حَمْدَوَيْه، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ، عَنْ حَنَانِ بْنِ سَدِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: كُنْتُ جَالِسًا عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَمَيْسِرٌ عِنْدَهُ، وَنَحْنُ فِي سَنَةِ ثَمَانٍ وَثَلَاثِينَ وَمِائَةٍ، فَقَالَ مَيْسِرُ بَيَّاعُ الزَّطِيِّ: جَعَلْتُ فَدَاكَ، عَجِبْتُ لِقَوْمٍ كَانُوا يَأْتُونَ مَعَنَا إِلَى هَذَا الْمَوْضِعِ، فَقُطِعَتْ آثَارُهُمْ وَفَنِيَتْ آجَالُهُمْ

translations.en: I was seated at Abu Abdillah’s (peace be upon him) together with Muyassir – this was in the year one hundred and thirty eight – when Muyassir the seller of clothes made by Jats [of India] said: May I be made your ransom, I am bewildered at a group who used to come with us to this place but their traces have been cut-off and their terms have ended.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ: وَمَنْ هُمْ؟ قُلْتُ: أَبُو الْخَطَّابِ وَأَصْحَابُهُ، وَكَانَ مُتَّكِئًا فَجَلَسَ، فَرَفَعَ إِصْبَعَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ قَالَ: عَلَى أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ لَعْنَةُ اللَّهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ، فَأَشْهَدُ بِاللَّهِ أَنَّهُ كَافِرٌ فَاسِقٌ مُشْرِكٌ، وَ أَنَّهُ يُحْشَرُ مَعَ فِرْعَوْنَ فِي أَشَدِّ الْعَذَابِ غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا

translations.en: He [the Imam] said: Who are they? I said: Abu al-Khattab and his fellows [who had been massacred]. He [the Imam] was resting on a cushion but sat up-straight [when he heard me say this] and raised his fingers to the sky and said: Upon Abi al-Khattab be the curse of Allah, His angels and all the people together, for I swear by Allah that he is a Kafir, Fasiq and Mushrik. He will be resurrected with Firaun in the most severe punishment by morning and night [allusion to 40:46].

chunks.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قَالَ: أَمَا وَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لَأَنْفَسُ عَلَى أَجْسَادٍ أُصِيبَتْ مَعَهُ النَّارَ

translations.en: Then he said: by Allah – I feel pity on the bodies that have entered the fire with him.

en.summary: Recorded in the year 138 AH, this narration from Al-Kashi highlights Imam al-Sadiq’s definitive declaration of *al-kufr al-nafs* (intrinsic disbelief) for Abu al-Khattab al-Andarani, distinguishing him from mere apostates by associating him with Pharaoh’s eternal torment. The Imam’s specific mention of pity for the followers' bodies underscores the Shia theological view that while the leader’s soul is condemned, the physical remains of his followers may still be treated with respect despite their shared fate.
en.seo_question: What is the status of Abu al-Khattab according to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)?

key_terms.أبو الخطاب: Abu al-Khattab, a prominent figure among the Qaramitah
